title: Centella + Panthenol - Barrier Repair Balm
body_html:
An intensive overnight balm formulated for stressed, sensitised, or compromised skin. Centella asiatica calms inflammation and supports recovery, while panthenol (provitamin B5) deeply hydrates and reinforces the barrier. Rich, occlusive, and deeply restorative.

Key ingredients: Centella Asiatica Extract, Panthenol 5%, Ceramide NP, Shea Butter

How to use: Apply a generous layer to clean skin in the evening as the final step. Use as a targeted spot treatment on dry patches or post-procedure. Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive.

title: Hyaluronic Acid + Aloe - Gel-Cream
body_html:
A featherlight gel-cream that delivers a burst of hydration without any heaviness or shine. Multi-weight hyaluronic acid hydrates at different levels of the skin, while aloe vera soothes. Perfect for oily, combination, or warm-weather routines.

Key ingredients: Sodium Hyaluronate (multi-weight), Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Glycerin

How to use: Apply to clean skin morning and evening as the final step of your routine, before SPF in the daytime.

title: Squalane + Shea - Rich Cream
body_html:
A deeply nourishing cream for dry, dehydrated, or mature skin. Squalane mimics the skin's natural oils to lock in moisture, while shea butter softens and protects. A comforting overnight treatment or rich day cream for colder months.

Key ingredients: Squalane, Shea Butter, Ceramide NP, Vitamin E

How to use: Apply a generous layer to clean skin in the evening, or use as a day cream in winter months. Massage gently until absorbed.

title: Ceramide + Peptide Complex - Daily Moisturiser
body_html:
A lightweight daily moisturiser that strengthens the skin barrier with ceramides while supporting firmness with a peptide complex. Absorbs quickly and layers well under SPF and makeup. Suitable for all skin types.

Key ingredients: Ceramide NP, Matrixyl 3000 (Peptide Complex), Glycerin, Squalane

How to use: Apply to clean skin morning and evening as the final step of your routine, before SPF in the daytime.

title: Vitamin C 15% + Ferulic - Brightening Serum
body_html:
A stable, high-strength vitamin C serum that brightens dull skin, evens tone, and protects against environmental stressors. Ferulic acid boosts antioxidant performance and improves stability, making this a daytime workhorse for radiance and prevention.

Key ingredients: L-Ascorbic Acid 15%, Ferulic Acid, Vitamin E

How to use: Apply 2–3 drops to clean skin in the morning, before moisturiser and SPF. Introduce gradually if new to vitamin C. Store away from direct sunlight.

title: Retinal 0.05% + Squalane - Overnight Renewal Serum
body_html:
An overnight resurfacing serum that uses retinal (retinaldehyde) — a more bioavailable form of vitamin A that works up to 11 times faster than retinol. Cushioned with squalane to minimise irritation while smoothing fine lines, refining texture, and evening tone.

Key ingredients: Retinaldehyde 0.05%, Squalane, Vitamin E

How to use: Apply 2–3 drops to clean dry skin in the evening only, 2–3 times per week to start. Always follow with SPF 30+ the next morning. Not suitable during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

title: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% - Blemish Control Serum
body_html:
A high-strength serum that targets blemishes, regulates sebum, and visibly reduces the appearance of enlarged pores. Niacinamide brightens uneven tone while zinc balances oil production, making this a workhorse for oily, combination, and blemish-prone skin.

Key ingredients: Niacinamide 10%, Zinc PCA 1%

How to use: Apply a few drops morning and evening to clean skin, before heavier creams. Avoid combining with high-strength vitamin C in the same routine.

title: Polyglutamic Acid 3% + Beta-Glucan - Hydration Complex Serum
body_html:
A next-generation hydrating serum that holds up to four times more moisture than hyaluronic acid. Polyglutamic acid forms a breathable film on the skin's surface, while beta-glucan calms and strengthens. Plumps fine lines and leaves skin smooth and dewy.

Key ingredients: Polyglutamic Acid 3%, Beta-Glucan, Glycerin

How to use: Apply 2–3 drops to clean skin morning and evening, before moisturiser. Suitable for daily use.

title: Squalane + Camellia - Oil Cleanser
body_html:
A silky cleansing oil cleanser that melts effortlessly into the skin to dissolve makeup, SPF, and excess sebum. Squalane mimics the skin's natural lipids while camellia oil delivers antioxidants. Emulsifies on contact with water for a clean rinse, leaving skin soft and nourished - never stripped.

Key ingredients: Squalane, Camellia Seed Oil, Sunflower Oil, Vitamin E

How to use: Massage 1–2 pumps into dry skin. Add water to emulsify, then rinse thoroughly. Follow with a second cleanser if double cleansing.

title: Ceramide + Oat - Cream Cleanser
body_html:
A rich, non-foaming cream cleanser that melts away makeup and impurities while reinforcing the skin barrier. Ceramides restore lipids, while colloidal oat soothes redness and irritation. Ideal for dry, sensitive, or compromised skin.

Key ingredients: Ceramide NP, Colloidal Oat, Squalane, Glycerin

How to use: Apply to dry or damp skin morning and evening. Massage gently, then rinse or wipe away with a soft cloth.

title: PHA 3% + Zinc - Exfoliating Cleanser
body_html:
A gentle daily exfoliating cleanser combining polyhydroxy acid (PHA) and zinc to refine skin texture, unclog pores, and balance oil production. PHAs offer the resurfacing benefits of AHAs with less irritation, making this suitable for sensitive and acne-prone skin.

Key ingredients: Gluconolactone (PHA) 3%, Zinc PCA, Niacinamide

How to use: Use morning or evening. Apply to damp skin, massage gently for 30 seconds, then rinse. Start 2–3 times per week and build up.

title: Amino Acid Complex - Gentle Gel Cleanser
body_html:
A sulphate-free gel cleanser formulated with amino acids to gently remove daily impurities, makeup, and excess oil without disrupting the skin barrier. Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive.

Key ingredients: Amino Acid Complex, Glycerin, Sodium PCA

How to use: Apply to damp skin morning and evening. Massage in circular motions, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.
